# Getting Help

- **Documentation**: see the root [README.md](../README.md) for setup, build, and test instructions; design and quality standards live in `.docs/`.
- **Usage questions and defects**: open an Issue in this repository (templates and requirements in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- **Installers and releases**: use the official repository's Releases and published download channels; Harken Hub manages multi-version installation and updates of Studio.
- **Licensing, infringement complaints, privacy requests and other support**: email **harken-support@xd.com**.
- **Security vulnerabilities**: do not open a public Issue — use the private reporting channel in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
